errors.text_span: Секторите изглеждат подредени около кръга без допълнителна визуална йерархизация
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the sectors are arranged without visual hierarchization. In fact, the sectors are clearly arranged in descending order of size (82.9%, 14.6%, 2.4%) in a clockwise direction, which is a form of visual hierarchy.

errors.text_span: , като най-големият розов сектор заема по-голямата част от пръстена
errors.evidence: This part of the sentence states that the largest sector takes up most of the ring, which is redundant and self-evident given that its value of 82.9% was already mentioned.
